mapper.select: select count(*) from evaluation_materials em where em.target_user_id = #{targetId} and em.evaluation_year = #{evaluationYear} and em.deleted_yn = 'N' and em.material_status = '인증' and exists ( select 1 from score_calculation_generations scg where scg.evaluation_material_id = em.evaluation_material_id )
select count(*) + 1 from evaluation_batch_requests where job_type = 'CONFIRMATION'
mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_batch_requests (batch_id, job_type, target_condition_json, request_user_id, request_status, request_id) values (#{batchId}, #{jobType}, #{targetConditionJson}::jsonb, #{requestUserId}, 'COMPLETED', #{requestId})

insert into final_evaluation_confirmations ( target_user_id, evaluation_year, confirmation_status, confirmation_batch_id, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, canceled_by, canceled_at, cancel_reason, request_id ) values (#{targetId}, #{evaluationYear}, #{confirmationStatus}, #{batchId}, #{requestUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, null, null, null, #{requestId}) on conflict (target_user_id, evaluation_year) do update set confirmation_status = excluded.confirmation_status, confirmation_batch_id = excluded.confirmation_batch_id, confirmed_by = excluded.confirmed_by, confirmed_at = excluded.confirmed_at, canceled_by = null, canceled_at = null, cancel_reason = null, request_id = excluded.request_id, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: update final_evaluation_confirmations set confirmation_status = '인증', confirmation_batch_id = #{batchId}, canceled_by = #{requestUserId}, canceled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, request_id = #{requestId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where target_user_id = #{targetId} and evaluation_year = #{evaluationYear} and confirmation_status = '평가확정'
mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_batch_results (batch_id, job_type, total_count, success_count, failure_count, excluded_count, error_detail_json, request_id) values (#{batchId}, #{jobType}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{failureCount}, #{excludedCount}, '[]'::jsonb, #{requestId}) on conflict (batch_id) do update set total_count = excluded.total_count, success_count = excluded.success_count, failure_count = excluded.failure_count, excluded_count = excluded.excluded_count, error_detail_json = excluded.error_detail_json, request_id = excluded.request_id
